reviews.review:
This game is something that I found by complete accident while scrolling through itch.io for any games that might seem interesting, and I am so happy that I bought and played it! It was a wonderful experience. The characters are likable and well-written, the story was good, the gameplay is easy but engaging, and although some of the visuals can be a bit rough-looking, the ones made specifically for this game all look great and give the characters and world a lot of emotion and tone. In fact, even the more default textures were always incredibly charming, in my opinion.

I think the only cons I can think of are the fact that the game is a bit rough around the edges. Namely, [spoiler] some of the transitions between chapters show up in a rather awkward way, sometimes involving scenes not properly fading in and out into each other, and I did notice a number of typos and misused words here and there in the dialogue and monster descriptions. Additionally, I couldn't seem to figure out how to scroll in some of the monster descriptions without closing the window, but that might just be my lack of modern RPGMaker controls knowledge. I'll admit that I'm mostly used to games made with RPGMaker 2003, but not so much other versions... [/spoiler]

But these are all very minor things! Yes, the game is absolutely worth playing. I loved it, and I hope others will, too :)

P.S., I've noticed that this game seems to be a part of a larger universe that the creator seems to be working on. You can find other Cubenen Garden stuff as well as other works by the creator here if anyone's interested: https://shepherdarmory.me/project-type/games-literature/
